Container.Name: Homelab-Hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Homelab Hub for monitoring and controlling Docker containers on this Unraid server. Includes container state, health, CPU/RAM usage, logs, search, and start/stop/restart/pause controls.
Container.Requires: The image is published by GitHub Actions to ghcr.io/arnas1111/homelab-hub.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used to access Homelab Hub from your LAN.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Direct access to the Unraid Docker Engine. Read/write access is required for container controls.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the Homelab Hub WebUI.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign login sessions. Example generator: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Display name for this Unraid server inside the Hub.

Config.Name: Internal Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal data directory. Normally leave unchanged.

Config.Name: Docker Host
Config.Description: Docker Engine socket used by the Hub. Normally leave unchanged.
